hero.title: HANDTOMOUSE
hero.headline: Independent creative direction and cultural strategy from Sydney.
hero.subline: I work where ideas meet culture — finding the small, precise angle no one else has noticed yet. Anyone can make something that looks current; the work is making something that still feels right in five years. That comes from research, reference, and restraint — knowing what to leave out, not just what to put in.
hero.origin: I'm not interested in trends or templates. I'm interested in ideas with backbone — things that stick because they mean something.

principles.text: You want to actually say something — not just look good
You're building for the long run, not chasing this quarter's trend
You'll trust the process — and push back when it matters

beliefs.text: Constraints are where the work gets interesting.
The brief is a starting point, not a finish line.
Slow thinking. Fast execution. In that order.
One precise idea beats five clever ones.
